_comment: The worked example, built post by post (user request, 10 October 2026). One entry per post: what the post adds to the commentary agent's design, what now works, the boundary it adds, the evidence it adds and the signal it introduces. Drawn from each chapter's x.12 worked-example slice and synthesis Part VI; all architectural judgement [AJ], generic and illustrative. Drives the progress strip on the post visuals (tools/render_post_visuals.js), the 'Worked example, step N' line in each first comment and the book's 'In the worked example' sections (tools/build_linkedin_book.py). Series order teaches the stack layer by layer; the real build order (evaluation and governance first) is set out at step 20.
use_case: An agent drafts the monthly Brinson-style performance-attribution commentary for a generic multi-asset fund; a portfolio manager approves every draft.

steps.adds: The use case and its boundary: the agent writes words around numbers it is given; it never produces a number, and a named portfolio manager approves every draft.
steps.now_works: Nothing is built yet; the design file starts empty.
steps.boundary: No figure may come from a model.
steps.evidence: The use-case record: owner, purpose and the approval rule.
steps.metric: None yet.

steps.adds: Four model roles, each pinned to an exact version: a primary drafting model, a fallback from a different vendor, a small classifier for reviewer edits, and a self-hosted open-weight model for anything touching unmasked client data.
steps.now_works: The agent has a primary and a qualified fallback in the approved region.
steps.boundary: No alias or preview model, and no model ever generates, rounds or corrects a figure.
steps.evidence: Model ID, version, route and region for every draft.
steps.metric: Qualified-alternative coverage: 100% for this use case.

steps.adds: A run ID on every call, tagged with use case and fund, joined to the trace; a monthly budget set from two month-end cycles; a per-run ceiling on model calls and tokens.
steps.now_works: Cost is reported per approved commentary and per fund, not per token.
steps.boundary: A runaway loop fails the run instead of the budget.
steps.evidence: Token counts and cost per draft, including regenerations.
steps.metric: Cost per approved commentary, with the regeneration rate beside it.

steps.adds: Drafting through the primary cloud's in-region model service, with capacity sized for the month-end peak and an open-weight route kept ready as the stressed exit.
steps.now_works: Every fund's draft can be produced in the narrow month-end window.
steps.boundary: No router or provider that cannot guarantee region and retention.
steps.evidence: Endpoint, region, retention setting and fallback flag per call.
steps.metric: Capacity headroom at the month-end peak.

steps.adds: One gateway route, attribution-commentary-draft: the workflow calls the route with its own identity and never holds a provider key; residency, fallback, budgets and inline guards live on the route.
steps.now_works: Switching to the qualified fallback is a configuration change, drilled in hours.
steps.boundary: If both models are unavailable, the route fails closed and the analyst is told the draft is delayed.
steps.evidence: The gateway's request record for every call.
steps.metric: Gateway coverage: 100% of model calls.

steps.adds: A pinned workflow graph: authorise, fetch the attribution snapshot, retrieve style and prior commentary, one drafting step, an evaluation gate, a human approval interrupt, then release by a separate service.
steps.now_works: Every run follows the same path; a failed run resumes from its checkpoint with the same numbers.
steps.boundary: Autonomy budget of one: the model drafts, but never chooses tools or order.
steps.evidence: The run's path through the graph and its checkpoints.
steps.metric: Path conformance: 100% of runs on the approved path.

steps.adds: A deterministic numeric comparator on every draft, injection screening of retrieved text, a PII check on output and denied topics (forecasts, advice).
steps.now_works: A draft with any figure, sign or direction word that disagrees with the engine is blocked before a human sees it.
steps.boundary: Guardrails back up the design; they never license more autonomy.
steps.evidence: Guard results for every draft.
steps.metric: False-positive rate of the guards on a labelled set.

steps.adds: Four tools behind the tool gateway: read-only attribution results with a snapshot hash, read-only fund reference data, a sandboxed calculator for derived figures, and retrieval of approved commentary.
steps.now_works: Every figure in the draft traces to a snapshot ID and hash.
steps.boundary: No write, publish or e-mail tool exists, so none can be misused.
steps.evidence: Every tool call with its arguments hash and decision.
steps.metric: Write tools in a read-only use case: zero.

steps.adds: A registered agent identity with a named sponsor; it acts on behalf of the analyst with a read-only, minutes-long token; a different portfolio manager approves with step-up authentication.
steps.now_works: Every action answers 'who did this, on whose behalf, under which policy'.
steps.boundary: The agent holds no standing credentials and can never approve.
steps.evidence: Audit events linking user, agent, tool, decision and trace ID.
steps.metric: Attribution completeness of audit events.

steps.adds: Deliberately little: a versioned glossary and style rules per fund, changed only by an approved pull request, recalled by version hash.
steps.now_works: Any commentary can be regenerated with exactly the memory it used.
steps.boundary: The agent may propose memory, never write it; no client identifiers in memory.
steps.evidence: The memory version hash in every trace.
steps.metric: Time to complete an erasure request across every copy.

steps.adds: The regulatory mapping: not an Annex III use; transparency and literacy duties; model vendors as material outsourcing with exit plans; the agent recorded in the model inventory.
steps.now_works: The design is defensible to a regulator, not only to an architect.
steps.boundary: Never assume a vendor's oversight covers the firm's duties.
steps.evidence: The regulatory assessment attached to the use-case record.
steps.metric: Concentration ratio by provider for important services.

steps.adds: One store already run by the firm, with three collections (prior commentaries, style guide, approved market notes) and fund-level entitlement filters applied inside the search.
steps.now_works: Context arrives only from documents the analyst is entitled to see.
steps.boundary: No unfiltered fallback: no permitted result means an empty result.
steps.evidence: Retrieved chunk IDs and versions per draft.
steps.metric: Filtered recall against unfiltered recall.

steps.adds: Defence in depth against a poisoned market note: nothing to hijack, numbers that cannot be rewritten, retrieved text marked as data, chunk screening, canary documents and human approval.
steps.now_works: No single control has to catch an injected instruction.
steps.boundary: Untrusted input, sensitive data and an outbound channel never meet in one agent.
steps.evidence: Screening and canary results per run.
steps.metric: Agents combining all three risk factors: zero.

steps.adds: Two-stage retrieval of comparable past commentary (embed and rerank), with both model versions pinned and tagged on every vector.
steps.now_works: The draft follows the fund's own style and comparable months.
steps.boundary: A mixed-version index is refused; migration runs as a shadow index behind a regression gate.
steps.evidence: Embedding and reranker versions per run.
steps.metric: Stage-one recall@k on a labelled question set.

steps.adds: A release manifest per monthly cycle (prompt set, model pins, retrieval settings, tool list, guard policy, eval thresholds), approved by pull request with a second approver and gated by the eval suite.
steps.now_works: Every setting that can change what a client reads is versioned and reversible.
steps.boundary: No production prompt is ever edited in a console.
steps.evidence: The manifest version stamped on every trace.
steps.metric: Rollback time, drilled.

steps.adds: Three corpora ingested under a control envelope: dual-parsed factsheet tables reconciled to the engine, prior commentaries with their permissions, and market notes from the approved register only.
steps.now_works: Every chunk carries its source, version, permissions, classification and lineage.
steps.boundary: No envelope, no index; parsed numbers are context only, never figures.
steps.evidence: Lineage IDs for every retrieved chunk.
steps.metric: Table cell exact-match on a golden set.

steps.adds: One privacy service called at six points: client names and mandates tokenised before any model call, detected again in output, re-identified only for the reviewing manager.
steps.now_works: The model writes about 'the mandate' without ever seeing whose it is.
steps.boundary: A clear-text identifier not in the approved inputs blocks the draft.
steps.evidence: The tokenised prompt and the token-map reference, never clear identifiers.
steps.metric: Identifier leakage in traces and outputs: zero.

steps.adds: The evaluation plane: numeric faithfulness (blocking), groundedness, style, trajectory, and a regression suite of 24 to 36 months of approved commentaries, all on one firm-owned telemetry spine.
steps.now_works: Every change of model, prompt, index or judge is tested before it reaches a client.
steps.boundary: Any numeric miss blocks; no human is asked to catch what code can check.
steps.evidence: Eval results for every draft and every release.
steps.metric: Numeric faithfulness: 100%.

steps.adds: The inventory entry for the use case and an evidence pack per approved commentary, keyed by one trace ID, written to an immutable archive.
steps.now_works: Any approved commentary can be explained and re-performed on request.
steps.boundary: The governed unit is the use case; the model is a vendor component inside it.
steps.evidence: The complete eight-part evidence pack.
steps.metric: Validation currency: 100%.

steps.adds: All eighteen pieces assembled into one request trace, with a 'may / must never' list in which every 'never' names the component that enforces it.
steps.now_works: The design is complete end to end on paper.
steps.boundary: Every 'must never' has an enforcing component, not a policy sentence.
steps.evidence: The eight-tile evidence pack, keyed to one trace ID.
steps.metric: Evidence-pack completeness: 100%.

steps.adds: The build order for real: governance and evaluation first, then the gateway, retrieval, the workflow and one read-only tool; memory and everything on the 'not yet' list waits for evidence.
steps.now_works: The agent can go live on the minimum platform.
steps.boundary: Nothing is built before the evidence says it is needed.
steps.evidence: The published 'not yet' list with a trigger for each item.
steps.metric: Gateway coverage of production calls: 100%.

steps.adds: A build, hybrid or buy decision for each of the seventeen components: build the evidence store, configuration and tools; buy models, serving and security tooling; hybrid elsewhere.
steps.now_works: Spend goes where the firm differentiates.
steps.boundary: Fine-tuning stays off the list.
steps.evidence: The decision and rationale per component.
steps.metric: Configuration coverage: 100% of settings under the manifest.

steps.adds: Thin firm-owned interfaces where switching is likely (routing contract, telemetry, datasets, privacy, retrieval) and none around the agent framework.
steps.now_works: Changing a vendor is a contained change.
steps.boundary: No firm-wide wrapper around frameworks.
steps.evidence: The interface inventory.
steps.metric: Framework currency: patches within an agreed window.

steps.adds: Lock-in accepted knowingly per component, with the firm's own records (evidence, configuration, datasets, credentials) kept out of any vendor's hands, and an index rebuild drilled.
steps.now_works: The agent survives the loss of any single vendor.
steps.boundary: No vendor-held store is ever the only copy of the firm's evidence.
steps.evidence: Exit and rebuild drill results.
steps.metric: Index rebuild time, tested twice a year.

steps.adds: The final selection: a firm-owned control and evidence plane, with replaceable components beneath it, and a published list of what was deliberately not selected.
steps.now_works: The worked example is complete, governed and ready to run.
steps.boundary: What was not selected stays off until the evidence changes.
steps.evidence: The signed-off architecture and its 'not selected' list.
steps.metric: Human-intervention rate, tracked and falling.
